sources.locator: Page 1: SPECIFICATIONS section and HOW TO ORDER table (model, actuator, bushing, terminations, plating, seal, RoHS)
sources.evidence_extract: SPECIFICATIONS: contact resistance 10 mOhm max initial; insulation resistance 1,000 MOhm min; dielectric strength 1,000 Vrms; operating temperature -40C to 85C; mechanical life 40,000 cycles. HOW TO ORDER: 1MS3 SP On-Off-On; T1 10.41 high; B1 8.89 high, keyway (thd std); M2 PC thru-hole; Q Silver; E Epoxy (std); S RoHS & Lead Free. Footer www.dailywell.com.tw 01. The suffix -5 is not decoded on this page.
